Monsanto Co New (MON) Shares Rose While Angelo Gordon & Company LP Has Upped Its Position; Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) Position Held by Cim Llc
May 26, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Cim Llc increased its stake in Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc (CMG) by 31.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cim Llc bought 3,472 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.39% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 14,645 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.23M, up from 11,173 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cim Llc who had been investing in Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.92 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $4.47 during the last trading session, reaching $428.96. About 454,493 shares traded. Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE:CMG) has declined 22.17% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.72% the S&P500.

Angelo held 725,000 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $84.67 million, up from 550,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
